policy: Every Rust workspace package has one hard maximum of 20,000 scc Code/CLOC under the checked checkout census. Every checked-in Rust file is assigned to exactly one package and counts in full unless Cargo metadata or a Bazel rust_test source closure proves exclusive standalone-test ownership; rust_library, rust_binary, and rust_proc_macro sources remain production even when testonly. Only packages proven over the limit by the immutable admission baseline may use an exact temporary ceiling; each ceiling is shrink-only and must be deleted at or below 20,000 CLOC. New exceptions, manual cfg/feature exclusions, and advisory tiers are forbidden.
